            JOINT MOTION TO EXTEND REBUTTAL TESTIMONY DEADLINE

       In accordance with New Mexico Public Regulation Commission (“Commission”) Rule of

Procedure 1.2.2.12 NMAC, Southwestern Public Service Company (“SPS”), New Mexico Large

Customer Group (“NMLCG”), Occidental Permian Ltd. (“OPL”), Louisiana Energy Services LLC

(“LES”), Federal Executive Agencies (“FEA”), Walmart Inc. (“Walmart”), Targa Resources Corp.

(“Targa”), Coalition for Clean Affordable Energy (“CCAE”), and Prosperity Works (“Joint

Movants”), move for an Order revising the procedural schedule to extend the deadline for all

rebuttal testimony from May 29, 2026, to June 9, 2026. In support of this Motion, Joint Movants

state the following.

       1.      On November 20, 2025, SPS filed its Application for Revision of its Retail Rates

under Advice Notice 341 and Other Associated Relief (“Application”), together with twenty-nine

(29) supporting direct testimonies.

       2.      On December 15, 2025, the Co-Hearing Examiners issued a Procedural Order

setting the initial procedural schedule in this case. Among other dates, that order set rebuttal

testimony for April 17, 2026, and scheduled the public hearing to begin on May 26, 2026.




Page 1 of 4
        3.      On March 13, 2026, the Co-Hearing Examiners issued an Order Granting Joint

Motion for a Revised Procedural Schedule. That order extended the rebuttal-testimony deadline to

May 29, 2026, vacated the May 26, 2026, hearing date, and reset the evidentiary hearing to begin

on July 7, 2026.

       4.      The parties are now engaged in settlement discussions that may narrow or resolve

issues that otherwise would require rebuttal or cross-rebuttal testimony.

       5.      Allowing additional time for the parties to prepare and file rebuttal testimony

would promote efficiency and conserve the resources of the parties, the Co-Hearing Examiners,

and the Commission. If the parties reach a stipulation, some or all rebuttal testimony may become

unnecessary.

       6.      The requested extension is reasonable. A June 9, 2026, deadline would still fall

approximately four weeks before the evidentiary hearing, which is scheduled to begin on July 7,

2026, and more than six months from the end of the rate suspension period.

       7.      Joint Movants therefore request that the Co-Hearing Examiners amend the

procedural schedule to set June 9, 2026, as the deadline for filing rebuttal testimony.

       8.      Commission Utility Division Staff, the New Mexico Department of Justice, and the

New Mexico Energy, Minerals, and Natural Resources Department do not oppose this motion.
